title: Density.
officialText:
The density of the sprayed fire-resistant material shall not be less than the density specified in the approved
fire-resistance design. Density of the sprayed fire-resistant material shall be determined in accordance with ASTM E 605. The test
samples for determining the density of the sprayed fire-resistant materials shall be selected as follows:
1. From each floor, roof and wall assembly at the rate of not less than one sample for every 2,500 square feet (232 m2) or portion
thereof of the sprayed area in each story.
2. From beams, girders, trusses and columns at the rate of not less than one sample for each type of structural member for each
2,500 square feet (232 m2) of floor area or portion thereof in each story.
